A little about Aster.

Aster is an original interface concept exploring a gentler kind of conversation space. Its abstract traveler, star garden, palette and layout were created for this demonstration.

Local HTML, CSS and JavaScript only.
Messages stay in memory until you reload or start again.
Replies are prewritten. There is no connected AI, server, account or external resource.
This is a new concept sample, not past client work.
